OPE_MEMB.description: Define Member (OPE_MEMB). Groups frame elements into members either manually from an element list or automatically, driven by the assign type, selection type, and single-element-member option.

Argument.description: Request payload that drives member definition over frame elements.

ELEM_LIST.description: Element List. Keys of the elements to group into members; used when specific elements are provided (e.g. MANUAL / SELECTION). If assigned, member definition is limited to these elements.

ASSIGN_TYPE.description: Assign Type. Case-insensitive. MANUAL defines members from the given element selection; AUTO defines members automatically from frame elements. MANUAL combined with SELECTION_TYPE ALL is rejected.

SELECTION_TYPE.description: Selection Type. Case-insensitive. ALL applies to all elements (valid with AUTO); SELECTION applies to the provided element list.

ALLOW_SINGLE.description: Allow Single Element Member. If true, a member consisting of a single element is permitted.
